items.title: 半導體暴跌散戶受重擊！摩根大通：資金未撤出AI交易 反而擴大布局
paras: 分析師指出，散戶投資人在過去一周積極搶進人工智慧(AI)概念半導體股，但他們都在周四(22日)的市場重挫中遭受重創。
摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)策略師Arun Jain表示，根據上周四至本周三的交易資金流向，散戶過去一周加碼買進晶片製造商、新型雲端服務(neocloud)商以及記憶體製造商。相較之下，對「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven)的買盤則有所減弱。
Jain表示，散戶對個別科技股的買入力道，已升至7月動能交易退潮以來的最高水準。

半導體股重挫 散戶熱門標的同步下跌

由於市場憂心AI基礎設施支出過於龐大，標普500指數周四收黑，晶片股領跌，半導體類股指標下跌6.7%，創6月以來最大單日跌幅。這使散戶投資人承受沉重壓力。
散戶買進最多的個股包括SanDisk(SNDK-US)、台積電(TSM-US)，以及近來社群媒體的散戶投資論壇中受矚目的Nebius Group(NBIS-S)，這三家公司股價周四均下跌至少4%。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)截至周二是散戶熱門買進標的第四名，但該公司公布令人鼓舞的財報、周二盤後股價大漲7.8%後，投資人轉而賣出。

科技ETF吸金創紀錄 散戶並未撤出AI交易

散戶對科技類股ETF的需求更為強勁。上周科技ETF資金流入規模創歷史第二高，部分原因是散戶在上周後半逢低買進。
科技ETF單日流入金額在上周五刷新歷史紀錄，使全周買進規模增至高於歷史平均值2.1個標準差的水準。VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)也是吸引大量資金的基金之一。
摩根大通的數據顯示，自各大雲端服務業者7月公布強勁財報迄今，散戶原本一直偏好科技七巨頭，如今資金轉向該群組以外的股票，顯示散戶並未因市場波動加劇而放棄AI交易，而是擴大投資範圍。
Integrity資產管理公司投資組合經理Joe Gilbert說：「由於AI生態系展現出比最初預期更持久的獲利能力，投資人已從科技七巨頭轉向更廣泛的科技股。」

科技業獲利成長支撐買盤 通膨疑慮仍添壓力

今年科技業一直是企業獲利成長的重要推手，根據美國銀行(BofA)彙整的數據，標普500資訊科技指數成分股企業第3季獲利預估將成長66%，增幅僅次於能源與通訊服務類股。
Gilbert說：「即使在科技七巨頭以外的領域，尤其是在利率較高的環境下，投資人仍有可能以較低的本益比，找到獲利強勁成長的機會。」
不過。目前散戶對科技股的熱情尚未轉化為全面的買盤激增。摩根大通數據顯示，散戶該周的整體資金流向仍相對平淡。

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 美股分裂成兩大陣營！AI股與其他類股多空拉鋸 投資人被甩得暈頭轉向
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Split Into Two Camps: AI Shares vs. Others, Investors Left Dizzy
paras: 美國股市分裂成兩大陣營的態勢愈來愈明顯，市場走勢宛如蹺蹺板，一端是人工智慧(AI)概念股，另一端則是其他類股。
標普500指數周四(22日)下跌逾1%，創7月以來最差表現，但同一天仍有超過300檔標普500成分股收漲。根據道瓊市場數據，大盤指數與成分股之間出現如此劇烈的分歧走勢，前一次發生在2025年1月。
市場戲劇性變化也反映出AI交易熱潮正面臨壓力。CNN的「恐懼與貪婪指數」發出強烈的恐懼訊號，而10年期美國公債殖利率則創下矽谷銀行(SVB)倒閉以來最大單日跌幅。
然而，通用磨坊(General Mills)(GIS-US)與金寶湯(Campbell’s)(CPB-US)等民生消費必需品類股周四分別大漲8%及8.7%，仍不足彌補熱門AI概念股的跌勢。
費城半導體指數(SOX)當天收黑6.72%，與6月高點相比回落逾26%，正式遁入「熊市」。投資人今年稍早大舉買進被視為AI產業「瓶頸」受惠者的股票，曾推動費半指數在短短數個月內翻倍，如今卻已大幅回檔。

AI股與其他類股像蹺蹺板 市場輪動加劇

Nationwide首席市場策略師Mark Hackett表示，這只是美股日益分裂成兩大陣營的最新例證，2026年的交易走勢開始像蹺蹺板，一端是AI概念股，另一端則是其他所有類股，「領漲類股出現如此頻繁的變化，實屬罕見。」
美國銀行資產管理集團(U.S. Bank Asset Management Group)投資長Dan Farley指出，投資人在兩大陣營之間反覆轉換，持續的來回震盪讓一部分人感到暈頭轉向。
Farley以形容這種情況「就像坐上遊樂園的旋轉飛椅一樣，人會被甩來甩去」。

指數與成分股走勢分歧創紀錄

美股多頭行情已持續四年，市場對AI提升勞動生產力與企業獲利的期待，推升標普500指數與科技股為主的那斯達克綜合指數，使兩大指數的權重愈來愈集中於被視為AI建置受惠者的企業。
標普500指數成分股的平均表現，與市場認為的AI受惠股愈來愈脫節。目前標普500市值最大的10家公司，合計約占整體指數市值的40%，由於標普500採市值加權，個股市值愈大，對指數每日漲跌的影響也愈大。
以截至周四收盤的行情來看，標普500等權重指數有望收漲，但被視為AI交易核心的費半指數則可能收跌。若周五行情沒有大幅逆轉，兩大指數將連續第八周走勢相反，創下可追溯至1990年代中期以來最長紀錄。

資金仍留在市場 但分析師警告恐出現同步賣壓

瑞穗美洲(Mizuho Americas)股票交易部門執行董事Farzin Azarm認為，這種分歧未必全是壞事，投資人並非把資金撤出市場，而是持續在不同類股之間調整配置。
Azarm說：「類股輪動正在加速，但投資人實際上只是在市場內部重新調動資金。」
大型機構投資人、例如避險基金，也正在加速這項趨勢。高盛(Goldman Sachs)主要券商業務部門近期數據顯示，避險基金客戶已大幅降低整體槓桿部位。
Azarm說：「去槓桿的幅度相當大，但在我看來，這其實是個好現象。」
不過，也有市場人士抱持較悲觀的看法。BTIG分析師Jonathan Krinsky周四指出，2026年指數表現與市場廣度之間的分歧達到極端程度。
今年超過30%的交易日中，標普500指數的漲跌方向與多數成分股相反，遠高於1996年以來任何一個完整年度的紀錄。若過往經驗仍具參考價值，指數成分股之間如此極端的表現分歧，恐怕難以無止境地持續下去。
Krinsky寫道：「我們認為，這種持續不斷的類股輪動終將停止，屆時市場可能出現相關性更高、各類股同步下跌的賣壓。」
paras_en: The divide in the U.S. equity market into two major camps is becoming increasingly clear, with market movement resembling a seesaw—one side occupied by artificial intelligence (AI) concept stocks and the other by all other sectors.

The S&P 500 fell more than 1% on Thursday the 22nd, marking its worst performance since July, yet over 300 S&P 500 constituents posted gains that same day. According to Dow Jones market data, such a stark divergence between the broad index and its components last occurred in January 2025.

The market’s dramatic swing also reflects mounting pressure on the AI trading frenzy. CNN’s Fear & Greed Index flashed a strong fear signal, while the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield posted its biggest single‑day drop since the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB).
Nevertheless, consumer staples such as General Mills (GIS‑US) and Campbell’s (CPB‑US) surged 8% and 8.7% respectively on Thursday, still insufficient to offset the decline in hot AI concept stocks.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) closed down 6.72% that day, more than 26% below its June peak, officially entering a bear market. Investors had earlier this year heavily bought stocks seen as beneficiaries of AI industry bottlenecks, which had helped double the SOX in just a few months, but those gains have now largely erased.

AI stocks and other sectors act like a seesaw, with market rotation intensifying. Nationwide chief market strategist Mark Hackett said this is merely the latest illustration of the U.S. market’s growing split into two camps, with 2026 trading dynamics now resembling a seesaw—one side AI concepts, the other all other sectors, and such frequent shifts among leading stocks are rare.

U.S. Bank Asset Management Group chief investment officer Dan Farley noted that investors keep flipping between the two camps, and the continual back‑and‑forth swings are leaving some people feeling dizzy.
Farley likened the situation to “riding a spinning swing at an amusement park—people get tossed around.”

Record divergence between index and component performance. The four‑year bull market in U.S. equities has been driven by expectations that AI will boost labor productivity and corporate earnings, lifting the S&P 500 and the tech‑heavy Nasdaq Composite, concentrating weight in firms seen as AI beneficiaries.

The average performance of S&P 500 constituents is increasingly out of sync with stocks perceived as AI winners. The ten largest companies by market cap now account for roughly 40% of the index’s total value, and because the S&P 500 is market‑cap weighted, larger stocks have a greater impact on daily index moves.

Based on Thursday’s closing data, equal‑weight S&P 500 indices could still end up higher, while the AI‑focused SOX is likely to close lower. If Friday’s session does not see a sharp reversal, the two indices will mark an eighth consecutive week of opposite moves—the longest such streak traceable back to the mid‑1990s.

Capital remains in the market, but analysts warn of possible synchronized selling pressure. Farzin Azarm, executive director of the equities trading division at Mizuho Americas, believes the split isn’t necessarily all bad; investors are not pulling money out of the market but are reallocating across sectors.
Azarm said, “Sector rotation is accelerating, but investors are essentially just shifting capital within the market.”

Large institutional players, such as hedge funds, are also accelerating this trend. Recent data from Goldman Sachs’ main brokerage division show hedge‑fund clients have sharply reduced overall leverage positions.
Azarm added, “The de‑leveraging is substantial, but in my view that’s actually a positive sign.”

However, some market participants hold a more pessimistic view. BTIG analyst Jonathan Krinsky noted on Thursday that the divergence between index performance and market breadth in 2026 has reached an extreme level.

More than 30% of trading days this year saw the S&P 500’s direction opposite that of the majority of its components, far exceeding any full‑year record since 1996. If history remains a guide, such an extreme split in component performance is unlikely to persist indefinitely.
Krinsky wrote, “We believe this relentless sector rotation will eventually cease, at which point the market may face higher correlation and a synchronized sell‑off across sectors.”

items.title: AI股快跌完了？小摩喊賣壓近尾聲 科技業握4000億美元後盾
items.title_en: Is the AI Stock Decline Almost Over? JPMorgan Says Selling Pressure Nears End, Tech Sector Backed by $400 Billion Financing Cushion
paras: 摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 在最新客戶報告中指出，近期人工智慧（AI）相關概念股的拋售潮可能已接近尾聲，並指出自9月中旬以來，股票部位已出現顯著的去槓桿與重置跡象。
策略師Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou表示，摩根大通的整體股票部位指標顯示，目前持倉水位已遠低於近期高峰。儘管短期仍面臨部分逆風，但部位調整可能開始抑制進一步下跌空間。
針對近期市場對「新興雲端業者」（Neoclouds）融資困境的疑慮，小摩認為，即使這類業者的融資模式證實無法持續，也不會打亂整體AI的資本支出（Capex）週期。Panigirtzoglou寫道：「在新興雲端業者既非整體AI生態系的核心，所佔比重也並不大。」
在今年全球上市科技公司預計產生的約2.2兆美元現金流與1.8兆美元資本支出中，新興雲端業者僅分別佔約300億美元及800億美元。
換言之，新興雲端業者所建置的AI基礎設施，完全可由超大規模雲端業者（Hyperscalers）等資產負債表更健全、營收來源多元的其他科技巨頭所吸收。
報告進一步指出，由於現金流超過資本支出，今年科技產業整體仍擁有約4,000億美元的融資盈餘。
小摩表示，科技業發債主因是為了在擴大資本支出的同時維持股票回購；倘若融資疑慮擴散，企業大可延後回購或進行更多循環融資。
換句話說，整體科技產業透過維持融資盈餘，自身即具備充足的內部資金後盾。
摩根大通指出，半導體目前約占全球股市整體風險資本的5分之1，因此容易受到波動加劇所引發的賣壓衝擊。該行研判，避險基金及商品交易顧問（CTA）等動能型投資人，已大致平倉先前偏高的半導體多頭部位。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US) noted in its latest client report that the recent sell‑off in AI‑related stocks may be nearing its end, observing significant deleveraging and repositioning in equity holdings since mid‑September.

Strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou said JPMorgan’s overall equity position indicator shows current holdings are far below recent peaks. While short‑term headwinds remain, the position adjustments could start limiting further downside.

Addressing recent market concerns about financing difficulties for “emerging cloud providers” (Neoclouds), JPMorgan believes that even if these firms’ financing models prove unsustainable, it won’t disrupt the overall AI capital‑expenditure (Capex) cycle. Panigirtzoglou wrote: “Emerging cloud providers are not core to the broader AI ecosystem and represent a small share.”

Of the roughly $2.2 trillion in cash flow and $1.8 trillion in Capex expected from globally listed tech companies this year, emerging cloud providers account for only about $30 billion and $80 billion respectively.

In other words, the AI infrastructure built by emerging cloud providers can be fully absorbed by larger, more financially robust tech giants such as hyperscalers, which have diversified revenue streams and stronger balance sheets.
The report further notes that because cash flow exceeds Capex, the tech sector as a whole still enjoys about $400 billion of financing surplus this year.

JPMorgan says the primary reason tech firms issue debt is to maintain share buybacks while expanding Capex; if financing concerns spread, companies can simply postpone buybacks or pursue additional revolving financing.
Put simply, by preserving a financing surplus, the tech industry already has ample internal funding support.

JPMorgan points out that semiconductors currently represent roughly one‑fifth of global equity market risk capital, making them vulnerable to heightened selling pressure from increased volatility. The bank assesses that momentum investors such as hedge funds and commodity trading advisors (CTAs) have largely unwound their previously oversized long positions in semiconductors.

items.title: 星巴克開始在中國認真管座位 消費者反應曝
items.title_en: Starbucks Starts Seriously Managing Seats in China, Consumer Reactions Revealed
paras: 星巴克(SBUX-US) 在中國開始把座位優先留給消費的人，但如何提醒點單，又成了新爭議。
「在星巴克開會一小時被提醒點單五次」在23日（周五）登上熱搜。上海一位消費者說，臨時參加線上會議，原本打算會後下單，卻在約一個半小時內被店員五次提醒。
她認為消費入座可以理解，但反覆催促讓她感到被「攆走」，最終去了附近另一家星巴克消費。
同一天，位於深圳福田居民區的一家星巴克，現場執行相對寬鬆。
據《界面新聞》報導，一位店員說，目前工作人員會對消費入座進行管理，是為了保障消費顧客的權益，「不然我們店裡的顧客都沒地方坐」。
這位店員表示，這家門市至少10天前就已開始進行管理，近幾日才擺上「請消費入座」桌牌。
工作日下午2點，這家擁有兩層空間的星巴克，上座率接近七成，攜帶電腦辦公的消費者接近一半，幾乎所有顧客的桌上都擺有星巴克飲品。
一個小時內，仍有三兩名顧客未點單短暫入座歇息，店員也未上前提醒消費。
本月22日起，星巴克在全中國門市施行消費入座，消費者的反應大致分為兩類：一類認為座位更好找、環境更安靜；另一類擔心過去可以自在停留的咖啡店，會變成不斷被詢問點單的地方。
支持者往往有過找不到座位的經歷。一位長期購買星巴克的消費者在社交平台上提到，過去曾遇到有人躺在座位上、吃外食或高聲交談，新規帶來的好處是，「起碼我能坐窗口了」。
也有消費者稱，到店感覺人少了，留下來的大多是已經點單、安靜辦公的顧客。
不滿則更多集中在提醒的頻率與時機。店內空位充裕時，店員是否需要反覆詢問？顧客表示稍後下單後，可以等多久？
門市之間也有尺度差異。據《新快報》報導，廣州有店員表示，顧客入座約10分鐘未點單會上前提醒；但同城另一家客流較少的門市，顧客入座25分鐘也未被詢問。
paras_en: Starbucks (SBUX-US) has begun giving priority to customers who actually purchase in China, but how to remind them to order has become a new controversy.

“Being reminded to order five times during a one‑hour meeting at Starbucks” trended on the hot search list on the 23rd (Friday). A consumer in Shanghai said she joined an impromptu online meeting, planned to order after it ended, but was reminded by staff five times within about an hour and a half.

She said she can understand the policy of seating only paying customers, but the repeated prompts made her feel like she was being “shooed away,” and she ultimately went to another nearby Starbucks to make her purchase.
On the same day, a Starbucks in a residential area of Futian, Shenzhen, was enforcing the rule more loosely on site.

According to Jiemian News, a staff member said that employees now manage seating for paying customers in order to protect their rights, “otherwise our customers would have nowhere to sit in the store.”
The employee said the store had started enforcing the policy at least ten days ago, and only in recent days had it put up a “Please seat only if you have ordered” sign on the tables.
At 2 p.m. on a weekday afternoon, the two‑level Starbucks was about 70 % full, with nearly half of the patrons using laptops for work, and almost every table had a Starbucks drink on it.
Within an hour, a few customers still sat briefly without ordering, and the staff did not approach them to remind them to order.

Starting on the 22nd of this month, Starbucks began applying the “pay‑to‑sit” rule in all its stores across China. Consumer reactions fall into two main camps: one says seats are easier to find and the environment quieter; the other worries that cafés, once places to linger freely, will become spots where you’re constantly asked to order.

Supporters often have past experiences of not finding a seat. A long‑time Starbucks buyer posted on social media that she used to encounter people lying on seats, eating take‑out, or speaking loudly, and the new rule’s benefit is that “at least I can sit by the window now.”
Other customers say the stores feel less crowded, and those who stay are mostly people who have already ordered and are working quietly.

Dissatisfaction focuses more on the frequency and timing of the reminders. When there are plenty of empty seats, should staff repeatedly ask? Customers wonder how long they can wait after they intend to order later.

There are also differences between stores. According to Xin Kuai Bao, a staff member in Guangzhou said customers are reminded after about ten minutes of sitting without ordering, whereas another less‑busy store in the same city does not ask even after 25 minutes of seating.

items.title: 華爾街最安全的股票 創下疫情崩盤以來最大單日漲幅
items.title_en: Wall Street's Safest Stock Posts Largest Single-Day Gain Since Pandemic Collapse
paras: 旗下擁有汰漬、幫寶適與 Charmin 等品牌的寶僑(PG-US) ，周四創下自 2020 年 3 月以來最大單日漲幅，市值增加逾 200 億美元。儘管大盤下跌，寶僑仍收在 2 月以來最高水準，距離 2026 年高點僅一步之遙。
寶僑交出了投資人最想看到的穩定成長。第一季營收成長 4%，主要來自銷量增加；汰漬及其他清潔用品所屬部門的營收成長 5%。公司也維持全年財測不變。
寶僑財務長 Andre Schulten接受《Yahoo Finance》訪問時表示：「消費者仍支持我們。」對急於尋求避風港的市場而言，這就夠了。
投資人願為穩定付出溢價
寶僑目前的估值，已超越部分科技巨頭。
投資人常以本益比衡量股票是否昂貴，也就是將股價除以每股盈餘。以明年預估獲利計算，寶僑本益比約為 22 倍，高於微軟(MSFT-US) 、Meta(META-US) 與輝達(NVDA-US) 。其中，輝達的本益比甚至不到寶僑的三分之二。
科技股估值下降，部分原因是華爾街調高未來獲利預估，使本益比的分母擴大、比值降低。近期科技股遭拋售、股價下跌，也進一步壓低估值。
換言之，寶僑投資人正以不低的價格，買進一家預估今年獲利最多僅成長 3% 的公司。
為何仍願意買單？投資人看重的是可預測性。無論景氣好壞，民眾都會持續購買牙膏與衛生紙，因此寶僑獲利鮮少意外低於預期。市場動盪時，這種穩定性就更有價值。
民生消費股全面走強
上漲的不只有寶僑。舒潔（Kleenex）與好奇（Huggies）製造商金百利克拉克(KMB-US) ，以及高露潔棕欖(CL-US) ，周四各上漲 4% 至 5%，可口可樂(KO-US)則以歷史新高作收。
持有多家日常消費品牌企業的必需消費類股 SPDR ETF(XLP-US)，剛創下自 2020 年 4 月以來最佳的連續 13 個交易日表現，周四單日漲幅也是 2025 年 4 月以來最大。同期，標普 500 指數走低，晶片股更遭重挫。
利率下滑也提供助力。民生消費股因股息穩定，常被視為債券替代品。當美國公債殖利率下跌，如同周四大幅下滑時，這些股票的股息相較之下便更具吸引力。
避險有其代價，而目前的代價相當高。
為低個位數的獲利成長支付約 22 倍本益比，意味著容錯空間有限。民生消費股通常在投資人不安時表現亮眼；一旦市場回穩，投資人重新追逐成長，這波溢價也可能迅速消退。
paras_en: Parent company Procter & Gamble (PG-US), which owns brands such as Tide, Pampers and Charmin, logged its biggest one‑day jump since March 2020 on Thursday, adding more than $20 billion to its market value. Despite a broader market decline, P&G closed at its highest level since February and is just a step away from its 2026 peak.

P&G delivered the steady growth investors crave. First‑quarter revenue rose 4%, driven mainly by higher sales, while the segment that includes Tide and other cleaning products posted a 5% revenue increase. The company also kept its full‑year outlook unchanged.
Chief Financial Officer Andre Schulten told Yahoo Finance, “Consumers are still behind us.” For a market desperate for a safe haven, that’s enough.
Investors are willing to pay a premium for stability.
P&G’s current valuation already exceeds that of some tech giants.

Investors often use the price‑to‑earnings (P/E) ratio to gauge whether a stock is expensive, dividing the share price by earnings per share. Based on next‑year profit estimates, P&G’s forward P/E is about 22×, higher than Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US). Nvidia’s P/E is even less than two‑thirds of P&G’s.

Tech‑stock valuations have slipped partly because Wall Street has raised future earnings forecasts, expanding the denominator of the P/E ratio and lowering the multiple. Recent sell‑offs and price drops in tech stocks have further compressed valuations.
In other words, P&G investors are buying a company that is projected to grow earnings by only about 3% this year at a relatively high price.

Why are they still willing to pay? Investors value predictability. Regardless of economic conditions, people keep buying toothpaste and toilet paper, so P&G’s earnings rarely miss expectations. In turbulent markets, that stability becomes even more valuable.
Consumer staples are broadly rallying.
It isn’t just P&G. Kleenex maker Kimberly‑Clark (KMB‑US) and Colgate‑Palmolive (CL‑US) each rose 4%‑5% on Thursday, while Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) closed at an all‑time high.

The consumer‑staples SPDR ETF (XLP‑US), which holds many everyday‑brand companies, just recorded its best 13‑day streak since April 2020, with Thursday’s single‑day gain also the biggest since April 2025. At the same time, the S&P 500 slipped and chip stocks took a heavy hit.

Falling rates also helped. Because consumer‑staple stocks pay steady dividends, they are often seen as bond substitutes. When U.S. Treasury yields drop—as they did sharply on Thursday—those dividends become relatively more attractive.
Hedging comes at a cost, and that cost is currently high.

Paying a roughly 22‑times P/E for low‑single‑digit earnings growth leaves little margin for error. Consumer staples tend to shine when investors are nervous; once the market steadies and investors chase growth again, this premium could evaporate quickly.

items.title: 美國官員：美方做好與伊朗長期對峙準備
items.title_en: U.S. Officials: America Ready for Long-Term Confrontation with Iran
paras: 美國常駐聯合國代表邁克爾·華爾茲表示，美國已做好與伊朗長期對峙的準備，雙方一年後可能仍陷僵局。
華爾茲承認，一年後美國和伊朗可能仍陷僵局，屆時雙方或許仍未就伊朗核計畫達成協議，荷姆茲海峽航運也可能無法恢復至衝突前水準。華爾茲希望伊朗能在上述情況發生前坐到談判桌前。
華爾茲稱，川普總統和美國海軍「有能力在可預見未來維持對伊朗港口的封鎖」，美國政府正在進一步擴大對伊朗的經濟施壓。
按照他的說法，只有處理掉伊朗高濃縮鈾，並與伊朗就其境內鈾濃縮活動達成實質性協議，美國在這場衝突中的戰略目標才算實現。
據美國方面21日消息，美國和以色列軍方已制定具體計畫，準備在11月美國國會期中選舉結束後再次打擊伊朗，但川普是否會批准實施這一計畫尚不確定。
川普最初曾表示對伊朗的軍事行動將持續「四至五周」。但眼下這場戰事仍未結束，燃油價格高漲，化肥和大宗商品供應短缺，波斯灣地區能源設施及出口通道也遭到嚴重破壞。
戰事持續和高物價引發美國民眾不滿。距離美國期中選舉不到兩周，川普的支持率已降至約31%，寫下他兩屆任期內歷史新低，共和黨面臨嚴峻選情。
paras_en: U.S. Permanent Representative to the United Nations Michael Walz said the United States is prepared for a long‑term standoff with Iran, and that the two sides could still be deadlocked a year from now.

Walz acknowledged that a year from now the U.S. and Iran may still be at an impasse, possibly without a deal on Iran’s nuclear program and with shipping through the Hormuz Strait unlikely to return to pre‑conflict levels. He hopes Iran will sit down at the negotiating table before that scenario unfolds.

Walz said former President Trump and the U.S. Navy “have the capability to maintain a blockade of Iranian ports in the foreseeable future,” and that the U.S. government is further expanding economic pressure on Iran.

According to him, the strategic goal for the United States in this conflict is only achieved by eliminating Iran’s highly enriched uranium and reaching a substantive agreement with Iran on its domestic uranium enrichment activities.

U.S. officials said on the 21st that the United States and Israeli militaries have drafted concrete plans to strike Iran again after the U.S. midterm elections in November, though it remains uncertain whether Trump will authorize the operation.

Trump initially said military action against Iran would last “four to five weeks.” However, the fighting continues, fuel prices are soaring, fertilizer and bulk‑commodity supplies are tight, and energy facilities and export routes in the Persian Gulf have been severely damaged.

The ongoing war and high prices have sparked public discontent in the United States. With less than two weeks until the midterm elections, Trump’s approval rating has fallen to about 31%, a historic low for his two‑term tenure, leaving the Republican Party facing a tough electoral outlook.

items.title: 橋水中國減碼黃金、審慎樂觀看多陸股
items.title_en: Bridgewater Cuts Gold Exposure in China, Remains Cautiously Optimistic on Mainland Stocks
paras: 《彭博》週五 (23 日) 報導，橋水基金 (Bridgewater Associates) 中國業務已逐步降低黃金超額配置，原因是利率上升推高持有黃金的機會成本，油價走高也壓抑印度等能源進口國的需求。相較之下，橋水對中國股票抱持「審慎樂觀」態度，認為估值、政策及潛在資金流向仍提供支撐。
橋水9月致投資者的信中表示，中國股市第 3 季下跌主要受到流動性因素影響，目前估值並不高，加上政策有利長期資金形成，而債券殖利率偏低，也可能促使更多資金轉向股票。
不過，橋水強調，信中評論僅反映截至 9 月底的判斷，投資觀點會隨市場情勢持續調整。公司表示，對中國資產維持「積極」立場。
在黃金配置方面，橋水表示，雖然央行與民間投資人分散資產的需求，仍為金價提供長期支撐，但在升息環境下，影響金價的多空因素已「大致平衡」，因此逐步削減先前的超額配置。
原油則是橋水第 3 季逐步加碼的資產。
公司指出，季初對原油原本抱持中性看法，隨後預期對高油價較不敏感的使用者將增加需求，因而提高配置，這項判斷後來獲得市場走勢驗證。橋水認為，供應中斷與庫存偏低，可能推動油價在第 4 季進一步走高。
提高主動管理比重，強化策略彈性
這些投資判斷對橋水中國績效的影響可望擴大。
公司正提高主動管理的重要性，讓人類經理人在交易與資產配置上擁有更多決策權。
橋水中國管理資產規模超過人民幣 600 億元 (約 90 億美元)，明顯領先 Two Sigma、D. E. Shaw 等國際同業在中國的業務。
橋水在信中表示，主動管理雖具高度挑戰，但成功的操作有助於在不同市場週期持續創造額外價值，提高報酬，並在不利環境下提供保護，包括對只做多資產的投資組合不利的市場情境。
截稿前，橋水對《彭博》報導不予置評。
前三季報酬 5.3%，第 3 季股票部位拖累績效
績效方面，橋水中國境內「全天候增強」策略今年前 3 季在未扣除費用前，累計報酬率為 5.3%，第 3 季則虧損約 1%。
其中，透過跨資產配置平衡風險的「全天候」部分，第 3 季報酬率為 0.1%，商品與債券交易獲利抵銷了股市下跌的損失。主動管理的 Alpha 部分則虧損 1.5%，以股票持倉拖累最大。
橋水中國於 2018 年推出境內基金，最初完全採用全天候投資組合，2019 年底加入主動管理，並於 2024 年提高其風險配置權重。
公司預期，持續提高主動管理比重，有助於增強策略的彈性與韌性，同時不致大幅改變長期風險與報酬特性。
橋水表示，儘管近期 AI 類股拋售與地緣政治因素引發市場劇烈波動，全天候增強策略仍展現一定韌性，凸顯分散報酬來源的價值。
公司指出，未來分散投資仍至關重要，同時也看見許多市場定價失衡帶來的機會，將持續透過主動管理掌握這些機會。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported on Friday (23rd) that Bridgewater Associates’ China business has been gradually reducing its excess gold allocation, citing rising interest rates that increase the opportunity cost of holding gold and higher oil prices that dampen demand from energy-importing countries such as India. In contrast, Bridgewater maintains a "cautiously optimistic" view on Chinese equities, arguing that valuation, policy, and potential capital flows still provide support.

In a letter to investors in September, Bridgewater noted that the decline in the Chinese market in the third quarter was largely driven by liquidity factors, that valuations are not high, that policy is conducive to long‑term capital formation, and that low bond yields may encourage more capital to flow into stocks.

However, Bridgewater emphasized that the commentary in the letter reflects judgments as of the end of September and that investment views will continue to adjust with market conditions. The firm stated it maintains an "active" stance on Chinese assets.

Regarding gold allocation, Bridgewater said that although central banks and private investors are diversifying assets, which still provides long‑term support for gold prices, the factors affecting gold in a rising‑rate environment are now "roughly balanced," so it is gradually trimming its previous excess allocation.
Crude oil was the asset Bridgewater incrementally increased in the third quarter.

The company noted that it originally held a neutral view on oil at the start of the quarter, but later expected demand from users less sensitive to high oil prices to rise, so it increased its allocation; this view was later validated by market movements. Bridgewater believes that supply disruptions and low inventories could push oil prices higher in the fourth quarter.
Increasing the proportion of active management, strengthening strategy flexibility
These investment judgments are expected to expand Bridgewater China’s performance impact.
The company is increasing the importance of active management, giving human managers more decision‑making power in trading and asset allocation.
Bridgewater China manages assets exceeding 60 billion yuan (about 9 billion USD), clearly ahead of international peers such as Two Sigma and D. E. Shaw in China.

Bridgewater stated in the letter that while active management is highly challenging, successful execution can create additional value across different market cycles, enhance returns, and provide protection in adverse environments, including market conditions that are unfavorable for long‑only portfolios.
Before the deadline, Bridgewater did not comment on Bloomberg’s report.
First‑three‑quarter return 5.3%, third‑quarter equity position dragged performance

In terms of performance, Bridgewater China’s all‑weather‑enhanced strategy earned a cumulative pre‑fee return of 5.3% in the first three quarters of the year, while the third quarter saw a loss of about 1%.

Of that, the all‑weather portion that balances risk through cross‑asset allocation returned 0.1% in the third quarter, with commodity and bond trading profits offsetting the equity market decline. The alpha from active management lost 1.5%, with equity positions dragging the most.
Bridgewater China launched its domestic fund in 2018, initially using a pure all‑weather portfolio; it added active management at the end of 2019 and increased its risk‑allocation weight in 2024.

The company expects that continuously increasing the proportion of active management will enhance strategy flexibility and resilience without significantly altering long‑term risk and return characteristics.

Bridgewater noted that despite recent sell‑offs in AI‑related stocks and geopolitical factors causing market volatility, the all‑weather‑enhanced strategy still showed resilience, highlighting the value of diversified return sources.

The company said that diversified investing will remain crucial in the future, and it also sees opportunities arising from many market pricing inefficiencies, which it will continue to capture through active management.

items.title: 鴻海斥12.03億美元 增資新加坡、法國及捷克子公司
items.title_en: Foxconn Spends $1.203 Billion to Capital‑Increase Singapore, France and Czech Subsidiaries
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(23)日公告，董事會通過對新加坡、法國及捷克子公司進行增資，交易金額分別為11.01億美元、5,800萬美元及4,400萬美元，合計斥資12.03億美元，作為長期投資用途。
鴻海公告指出，將對新加坡子公司eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd.進行現金增資，認購普通股11.01億股，每股價格1美元，交易總金額11.01億美元。增資後，鴻海累計持有該公司19.13億股，持股比例達100%。
此外，鴻海也將對法國子公司Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS增資5,800萬美元，取得約510.07萬股，每股價格10歐元。增資後，鴻海累計持股數為510.07萬股，持股比例達100%。
在捷克方面，鴻海將對子公司Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o.增資4,400萬美元，約當9.44億捷克克朗。公告顯示，鴻海累計持有該公司股權金額為9.44億捷克克朗，持股比例90.42%；另由Foxconn Holdings B.V.持有1億捷克克朗，持股比例9.58%。
鴻海表示，上述三筆投資均以長期投資為目的，相關增資案均經董事會決議通過。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today (23) that its board approved capital increases for subsidiaries in Singapore, France and the Czech Republic, with transaction amounts of $1.101 billion, $58 million and $44 million respectively, totaling $1.203 billion, for long‑term investment purposes.

Foxconn said it will make a cash capital increase in its Singapore subsidiary eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd., subscribing for 1.101 billion ordinary shares at $1 per share, for a total of $1.101 billion. After the increase, Foxconn will hold a cumulative 1.913 billion shares, representing 100% ownership.

In addition, Foxconn will increase capital in its French subsidiary Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS by $58 million, acquiring about 5.1007 million shares at €10 per share. After the increase, Foxconn’s cumulative holding will be 5.1007 million shares, representing 100% ownership.

In the Czech Republic, Foxconn will increase capital in its subsidiary Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o. by $44 million, equivalent to CZK 944 million. The announcement shows Foxconn’s cumulative equity in the company is CZK 944 million, representing a 90.42% stake; Foxconn Holdings B.V. holds CZK 100 million, a 9.58% stake.
Foxconn said all three investments are for long‑term purposes and the capital increase plans have been approved by the board.

items.title: 〈工業生產指數〉連31紅！工業與製造業生產指數雙創新高 估10月續紅
items.title_en: Industrial Production Index Extends 31-Month Growth Streak; Both Industrial and Manufacturing Indices Hit Record Highs, October Expected to Remain Positive
paras: 受惠於人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算及雲端資料服務等應用需求持續熱絡，加上消費性電子新品備貨潮挹注，經濟部於今（23）日公布最新統計數據，9月工業生產指數為 140.76，較上年同月增加 19.17%；其中製造業生產指數達 143.31，年增 20.21%。兩大指數皆創下歷年同月新高，雙雙寫下連續 31 個月正成長紀錄。 展望10月，在AI與年終旺季帶動下，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
累計今年前 9 個月來看，工業生產指數為 133.10，較上年同期增加 20.53%；製造業生產指數則為 135.48，年增 21.83%，展現出台灣科技製造業強韌的成長動能。
深入分析各產業表現，資訊電子工業成為推升本月指數創高的絕對主力，年增率高達 27.42%。其中：
電子零組件業： 9月年增 23.62%，主因受惠高效能運算與 AI 應用需求維持強勁，伴隨消費性電子新品備貨，帶動 12 吋晶圓代工、IC 封測、記憶體、IC 設計及載板等產品生產成長，累計前 9 月較上年同期增加 21.07%。
電腦電子產品及光學製品業： 隨著 AI 應用與雲端服務蓬勃發展，促使全球雲端服務大廠加速布建 AI 基礎設施，加以半導體設備投資動能續強，推升伺服器、半導體檢測設備及零組件、交換器、固態硬碟等產品生產大幅成長，年增率高達 45.92%，累計前 9 月更大增 80.05%。
在傳統產業方面，受惠於半導體業者持續擴產以及 AI 供應鏈的外溢需求，部分產業同步展現增產態勢：
機械設備業： 年增 26.02%，主因半導體廠持續拓展先進製程與高階封測產能，帶動電子與半導體生產用設備及零組件、機械傳動設備等產量擴增，外加工具機訂單續增所致。
基本金屬業與汽車零組件業： 基本金屬業年增 1.39%，主因市場需求緩步回溫，熱軋鋼捲板與靶材等產品生產增加；汽車及其零件業則因市場需求增溫及電動車政策加持，年增 2.35%。
化學材料及肥料業： 則因部分產品市場回溫力道仍緩，年減 4.29%（惟拋光矽晶圓受惠半導體需求持續增產）。

展望未來，經濟部指出，雖然全球經濟成長動能仍受到地緣政治及貿易政策等不確定性因素影響，但受惠於 AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等新興科技應用需求持續擴增，全球雲端大廠積極投資 AI 基礎設施，將有助於延續我國半導體先進製程、高階封裝及伺服器等相關供應鏈的生產動能。再加上年終消費旺季的備貨需求陸續湧現，預期將可有效支撐我國製造業生產維持穩健成長態勢。綜合研判，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
paras_en: Benefiting from sustained demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high‑performance computing and cloud data services, as well as a surge in inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, the Ministry of Economic Affairs released the latest statistics on the 23rd. September’s industrial production index was 140.76, up 19.17% year‑on‑year; the manufacturing production index reached 143.31, up 20.21% YoY. Both indices set new monthly records and marked the 31st consecutive month of growth. Looking ahead to October, driven by AI and the year‑end peak season, the manufacturing production index is projected to range from 141.56 to 145.86, representing a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

Cumulatively for the first nine months of this year, the industrial production index stood at 133.10, 20.53% higher than the same period last year; the manufacturing production index was 135.48, up 21.83% YoY, showcasing the robust growth momentum of Taiwan’s technology manufacturing sector.
A detailed sector analysis shows that the information and electronics industry was the absolute driver behind this month’s record‑high index, posting a year‑over‑year growth of 27.42%.

Electronic components: In September, the sector grew 23.62% YoY, mainly due to strong demand from high‑performance computing and AI applications, coupled with inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, which boosted production of 12‑inch wafer foundry, IC packaging and testing, memory, IC design and substrates, resulting in a 21.07% increase for the first nine months compared with last year.

Computer electronic products and optical products: The booming development of AI applications and cloud services has prompted global cloud providers to accelerate the deployment of AI infrastructure, further strengthening semiconductor equipment investment. This drove substantial production growth in servers, semiconductor testing equipment and components, switches, solid‑state drives and other products, with a 45.92% YoY increase and an 80.05% rise for the first nine months.
In traditional industries, the continued expansion of semiconductor manufacturers and spill‑over demand from the AI supply chain have led several sectors to show production gains as well.

Machinery and equipment: The sector grew 26.02% YoY, driven by semiconductor firms expanding advanced processes and high‑end packaging capacity, which increased demand for equipment and components used in electronics and semiconductor production, as well as mechanical transmission equipment, alongside continued growth in machine‑tool orders.

Basic metal and automotive parts: Basic metal rose 1.39% YoY, reflecting a gradual recovery in market demand and higher output of hot‑rolled steel coils, plates and target materials. The automotive and parts sector, buoyed by warming demand and supportive electric‑vehicle policies, grew 2.35% YoY.

Chemical materials and fertilizer: This sector declined 4.29% YoY as demand for some products remained weak, although polished silicon wafers benefited from ongoing semiconductor demand and saw production increases.

Looking forward, the Ministry of Economic Affairs notes that while global economic growth is still subject to geopolitical and trade‑policy uncertainties, the expanding demand for emerging technologies such as AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with aggressive AI infrastructure investments by major cloud providers, will help sustain production momentum in Taiwan’s advanced semiconductor processes, high‑end packaging and server supply chains. Coupled with the upcoming year‑end consumer‑spending season, these factors are expected to support steady growth in the nation’s manufacturing output. The ministry estimates the October manufacturing production index will range from 141.56 to 145.86, reflecting a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

items.title: 台積電運動會因颱風喊卡 「小禮物」特別獎金正常發放加碼到3萬元
items.title_en: TSMC Sports Day Cancelled by Typhoon, ‘Small Gift’ Special Bonus Still Paid and Boosted to NT$30,000
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)原定於10月24日運動會因為颱風薔琵取消，不過，「小禮物」特別獎金據悉仍將照常發出，且加碼達3萬元，高於去年的2.5萬元。
台積電近年運動會都發放特別獎金，且逐年加碼，從2023年1.6萬元、到2024年2萬元、2025年2.5萬元，到今年3萬元，只要符合資格的員工均可領到。
受到薔琵颱風影響，新竹縣市政府公告10月23日停止上班，台積電表示，由於運動會的準備工作也受到影響，考量人員安全，因此運動會將取消辦理。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) had scheduled its annual sports day for October 24, but the event was called off because of Typhoon Chanh‑pi. However, the “small‑gift” special bonus is reportedly still being issued as usual, and the amount has been increased to NT$30,000, up from NT$25,000 last year.

In recent years TSMC has awarded a special bonus at its sports day and has been raising the amount each year—NT$16,000 in 2023, NT$20,000 in 2024, NT$25,000 in 2025, and this year NT$30,000. Any employee who meets the eligibility criteria will receive the bonus.

Due to the impact of Typhoon Chanh‑pi, the Hsinchu County and City governments announced a work‑stop on October 23. TSMC said that because the preparation for the sports day was also affected and to ensure staff safety, the event will be cancelled.

items.title: 聯茂8、9月合賺22.1億元EPS 6.08元超越H1 前3季提前賺逾一股本
items.title_en: Lianmao Posts NT$2.21 B Combined Profit for August‑September, EPS NT$6.08 Beats H1; First Three Quarters Earn Over One Year’s Capital in Advance
paras: CCL廠聯茂電子(6213-TW)今(23)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年9月營收達58.24億元，創歷史新高，單月稅後純益達12.86億元，每股純益(EPS)3.54元。加計8月稅後純益9.24億元，聯茂第三季光兩個月累計稅後純益就達22.1億元，每股純益合計6.08元，不僅獲利表現強勁，更已超越上半年稅後純益15.94億元。
聯茂2026年上半年營收為206.73億元，毛利率17.33%，稅後純益15.94億元，每股純益4.39元。若加計第三季8、9月獲利，前三季累計稅後純益已達38.04億元，每股純益合計10.47元，提前賺逾一個股本，獲利動能持續升溫。
在高階產品需求強勁帶動下，聯茂積極擴充泰國、江西、無錫及台灣等生產基地產能，預計2026年全球總產能將達每月570萬張。其中，泰國大型生產基地持續推進三期投資計畫，第一期預計於今年底完成，屆時產能將由每月30萬張倍增至60萬張，進一步提升高階材料供應能力。
聯茂泰國第二期擴產計畫也已打樁動工，初期規劃新增每月30萬張產能，公司規劃最快於2026年投產。隨著各地擴產計畫陸續推進，聯茂預估2029年全球總產能將進一步擴大至每月915萬張，持續因應AI及高階電子材料市場需求。
同時，聯茂持續提升泰國廠的技術層次，以因應在地PCB廠的擴廠生產需求，預計聯茂泰國廠於2026年完成M8 CCL的技術轉移，並於2027年完成M9產品技術轉移至泰國。而聯茂本身在M10產品的開發也在認證之中。
聯茂董事長陳進財先前指出，聯茂自2026年至2030年的全球生產規劃皆已完備，目前正依進度進行投資，但2026年尚無在公開市場籌資的規劃。
聯茂9月營收達58.2億元，月增15.5%、年增110.7%；第三季營收達156億元，優於市場預期並再創單季歷史新高。累計前9月營收達329.05億元，已超越歷年全年營收。法人分析，主要受惠於產品漲價效益持續反映，以及伺服器市場需求維持強勁。
paras_en: CCL manufacturer Lianmao Electronics (6213‑TW) today (23) announced the latest profit information, September 2026 revenue reached NT$5.824 billion, a historic high, monthly after‑tax net profit was NT$1.286 billion, EPS NT$3.54. Adding August after‑tax profit of NT$924 million, Lianmao’s Q3 two‑month cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$2.21 billion, EPS total NT$6.08, not only a strong performance but already exceeds the H1 after‑tax profit of NT$1.594 billion.

Lianmao’s H1 2026 revenue was NT$20.673 billion, gross margin 17.33%, after‑tax profit NT$1.594 billion, EPS NT$4.39. Including Q3 August‑September profit, the first three quarters cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$3.804 billion, EPS NT$10.47, earning more than one year’s equity in advance, and profit momentum continues to heat up.

Driven by strong demand for high‑end products, Lianmao is actively expanding capacity at its plants in Thailand, Jiangxi, Wuxi and Taiwan, expecting total global capacity in 2026 to reach 5.7 million sheets per month. The large Thailand plant continues its Phase‑3 investment, with Phase‑1 expected to be completed by year‑end, raising capacity from 300,000 to 600,000 sheets per month, further boosting high‑end material supply capability.

The second‑phase expansion at the Thailand plant has also begun pile‑driving, initially adding 300,000 sheets per month, with the company planning to start production as early as 2026. As expansion projects progress, Lianmao forecasts global capacity to grow to 9.15 million sheets per month by 2029, continuing to meet AI and high‑end electronic material market demand.

At the same time, Lianmao is upgrading the technology level of its Thailand factory to meet local PCB fab expansion needs, expecting to complete M8 CCL technology transfer at the Thailand plant in 2026 and finish M9 product technology transfer there in 2027. Lianmao’s own M10 product development is also under certification.

Chairman Chen Jin‑cai previously noted that Lianmao’s global production plan for 2026‑2030 is fully set, and investments are proceeding on schedule, but there is no plan to raise capital in the public market in 2026.

Lianmao’s September revenue hit NT$5.82 billion, up 15.5% month‑over‑month and 110.7% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue reached NT$15.6 billion, beating market expectations and setting a new quarterly record. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$32.905 billion, surpassing any full‑year revenue in history. Analysts say the results are mainly due to continued price‑increase benefits and strong server market demand.

items.title: 玉晶光獲3M參與私募股款已到位持股4.68% 自結9月EPS達3.85元
items.title_en: Yujing Optical Secures 3M Participation in Private Placement, Stake Reaches 4.68%, September EPS Hits T$3.85
paras: 獲美商3M以逾48億元參與私募現增案並取得約 4.68% 股權的光學鏡頭與精密光學元件大廠玉晶光(3406-TW)，今(23)日公布最新自結獲利資訊，玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，自結單月稅後純益4.34億元，年減15%，單月每股純益3.85元。
玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。
展望第四季營運，玉晶光指出，端視客戶新機銷售狀況，另其它領域的產品目前仍在積極送樣、認證，目前進度符合公司預期。
3M 預計參與玉晶光的私募發行新股，認購玉晶光普通股5534張，每股認購價格為869.6元，投資總金額高達48.13億元（約1.5億美金元），股款並已匯入，3M透過參與私募將取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光長期積累的精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
玉晶光在2026年上半年營收118.23億元，毛利率33.37%，稅後純益15.77億元，每股純益13.99元。
paras_en: Yujing Optical (3406‑TW), a leading manufacturer of optical lenses and precision optical components that received participation from U.S. company 3M in a private placement raising over T$4.8 billion and acquiring about a 4.68% stake, announced its latest self‑reported profit figures today (23rd). For September 2026, Yujing posted revenue of T$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year, with a net profit after tax of T$434 million, a 15% year‑over‑year decline, and earnings per share of T$3.85 for the month.

The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, saw Yujing’s quarterly revenue reach T$7.816 billion, entering a historically high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, Yujing’s revenue totaled T$19.631 billion, a 10.21% increase year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, Yujing said its performance will depend on customers’ new product sales, while products in other segments are still being actively sampled and certified, with progress currently meeting the company’s expectations.

3M plans to participate in Yujing’s private placement of new shares, subscribing to 5,534 ordinary shares at a price of T$869.6 per share, for a total investment of T$4.813 billion (approximately US$150 million). The funds have already been transferred, and through this private placement 3M will obtain roughly a 4.68% equity stake in Yujing.

The extensive collaboration between Yujing and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing’s long‑standing precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑precision assembly technology. Yujing’s production team will fully support the mass‑production preparation of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.
In the first half of 2026, Yujing reported revenue of T$11.823 billion, a gross margin of 33.37%, net profit after tax of T$1.577 billion, and earnings per share of T$13.99.

items.title: 揚明光連三季獲利 前三季EPS 0.11元
items.title_en: Yang Ming Optical Posts Profit for Three Consecutive Quarters, EPS 0.11 NT$ for First Three Quarters
paras: 光學元件廠揚明光學(3504-TW)今(23)日召開董事會，公告第三季稅後純益122萬元，季減76.25%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益0.01元；前三季稅後純益1234萬元，每股純益0.11元，較去年同期由虧轉盈。
展望第四季，揚明光學指出，光學元件類產品受物流投影鏡頭客戶啟動新版本變更計畫影響，相關需求可能遞延或暫緩，預估出貨動能將下修；3D列印產品隨新機種逐步導入客戶端測試，出貨預期略增；其餘產品線因接近年底，客戶備貨轉趨保守，預計出貨較第三季持平或略減。整體而言，預估第四季出貨量將較第三季減少。
揚明光學2026年第三季營收7.46億元，毛利率16.8%，季增0.36個百分點、年減0.22個百分點，營業損失872萬元；前三季營收21.7億元，毛利率17.13%，年增0.94個百分點。
揚明光學表示，第三季智能家居新機種持續放量，但低階舊型鏡頭也進入終止階段，取像光學產品出貨表現持平；光學元件類產品因客戶AR眼鏡進入量產，出貨較上季增加；3D列印產品則因進入新舊機種銜接期，受到客戶端調整舊機種庫存及新機驗證雙重影響，本季出貨相對放緩。
車用產品方面，揚明光學第三季隨LiDAR鏡頭新機種順利量產，逐步取代舊機種，帶動出貨量略增。
paras_en: Optical component manufacturer Yang Ming Optical (3504‑TW) held its board meeting today (23rd) and announced a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.22 million, down 76.25% quarter‑over‑quarter, turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year, resulting in earnings per share of NT$0.01; for the first three quarters the after‑tax net profit was NT$12.34 million, EPS NT$0.11, also turning a loss into a profit versus the prior year.

Looking ahead to Q4, Yang Ming Optical noted that demand for optical‑component products may be delayed or postponed due to logistics projection‑lens customers launching new version change programs, so shipment momentum is expected to be revised downward; 3D‑printing products are gradually being introduced to customer testing with new models, so shipments are expected to rise slightly; other product lines, as the year‑end approaches, see customers becoming more conservative in inventory, so shipments are expected to be flat or slightly lower than Q3. Overall, Q4 shipment volume is projected to be lower than Q3.

Yang Ming Optical reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$746 million, gross margin 16.8%, up 0.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but down 0.22 points year‑over‑year, and an operating loss of NT$8.72 million; for the first three quarters revenue was NT$2.17 billion, gross margin 17.13%, up 0.94 percentage points year‑over‑year.

The company said that in Q3 the new smart‑home models continued to ramp up, while low‑end legacy lenses entered the phase‑out stage, keeping imaging‑optics product shipments flat; optical‑component products saw higher shipments as a customer’s AR glasses entered mass production; 3D‑printing products experienced a slowdown this quarter because they are in a transition period between old and new models, affected by customers adjusting old‑model inventory and validating new models.
In the automotive segment, Yang Ming Optical’s new LiDAR lens models were successfully mass‑produced in Q3, gradually replacing older models and driving a modest increase in shipment volume.

items.title: 生合首次發行CB預計10/30上櫃交易 今年市場籌資將達5.4億元
items.title_en: Shenghe's First CB Issuance Expected to Trade OTC on Oct 30; Market Fundraising This Year Will Reach NT$540 million
paras: 益生菌原料大廠生合(1295-TW)2026年積極進行市場籌資，繼8月完成以發行現增股3125張完成1.4億元的籌資之後，再以完成發行面額4億元的國內第一次無擔保轉換公司債(CB)籌資，這筆CB預計在10月30日上櫃掛牌交易。
生合8月完成的現增案以每股45元發行，募集金額1.4億元，而本月再發行面額4億元的國內第一次無擔保轉換公司債(CB)籌資，轉換價爲50元，預計在10月30日上櫃交易，今年的生合的現增、發行CB的市場兩筆市場籌資案，合計募5.4億元。
生合今年來市場籌資5.4億元，主要用途爲償還銀行借款。
生合2026年1-6月營收5.11億元，毛利率49.76%，稅後純益6803萬元，每股純益1.97元。
生合股價10月22日收盤價報46.75元。
paras_en: Probiotic ingredient giant Shenghe (1295‑TW) is actively raising capital in 2026. items.title_en: Taishin Private Bank Asia-Pacific Flagship Branch Officially Opens, Partnering with Union Bancaire Privée to Offer International-Grade Private Banking Services
paras: 台新銀行積極響應政府推動亞洲資產管理中心政策，持續深耕高資產財富管理市場，今(23)日正式成立「台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店」，展現布局南臺灣、連結亞洲財富管理市場的決心。此次開幕典禮由台新銀行私銀暨高端理財事業總處執行長林尚愷主持，並與瑞聯銀行(Union Bancaire Privée, UBP)簽署策略聯盟合作備忘錄，借助瑞聯銀行作為瑞士規模最大的家族所有私人銀行之一在高資產財富管理服務及國際投資的專業優勢，進一步強化台新私人銀行的國際視野與服務量能。

台新私銀總處執行長林尚愷表示，隨著台新新光金控合併逐步展現集團規模效益，客戶基礎擴大至逾1,100萬戶。為因應快速成長的高端財富管理需求，台新銀行今(2026)年正式成立「私銀暨高端理財事業總處」，匯聚金融資歷逾20年且具備CFP、AFP等專業認證的財富規劃顧問團隊，結合具豐富實務經驗的律師、會計師等專業人士，全面強化高資產客群財富規劃服務。面對全球稅務變局與企業世代交替浪潮，台新私銀家族辦公室以家族投資管理、財富傳承、稅務服務、家族治理與生活管家為五大核心領域，提供高資產客戶全方位的家辦式顧問服務。

看好台新新光合併後的龐大資源優勢及深耕在地客戶的深厚經驗，瑞聯銀行亞洲區行政總裁Michael Blake表示，雙方合作建基於共同企業願景、以客為本及高度互補的優勢之上，台新銀行精準掌握臺灣市場高資產客戶需求，瑞聯銀行則具備全球投資視野與國際財富管理經驗；未來瑞聯銀行將分享全球市場洞察、資產配置與投資專業，並透過人才培育與專業交流，協助台新私人銀行團隊拓展國際視野、深化專業能力，共同推動臺灣私人銀行服務持續升級。
台新銀行深耕財富管理35年，持續投入高資產客戶服務，逐步建構涵蓋專業團隊、產品平台，以及臺灣、香港、新加坡據點的完整私銀服務體系。此次與瑞聯銀行策略合作最重要的意義，在於將國際經驗轉化為服務客戶的能力。未來台新銀行將結合自身對臺灣市場及高資產客戶需求的精準掌握，借重瑞聯銀行全球市場洞察與專業經驗，持續精進資產配置、產品服務及財富管理能力，提供更完整、更專業且更具國際視野的私人銀行服務。
展望未來，台新私人銀行將持續以臺灣為根基、連結亞洲、接軌全球，以「認真專業、永續傳承」的精神，實踐「我們承諾守護您的託付」的理念，致力成為高資產客戶與家族長期信賴的「資產負債管理夥伴」，陪伴客戶穩健管理財富、創造長期價值，實現跨世代的財富永續與傳承。
paras_en: Taishin Bank is actively responding to the government’s push for an Asian asset‑management hub and continues to deepen its high‑net‑worth wealth‑management market. On the 23rd, it formally launched the “Taishin Private Bank Asia‑Pacific Flagship Branch,” showcasing its commitment to expanding in southern Taiwan and linking to the Asian wealth‑management market. The opening ceremony was hosted by Lin Shang‑kai, Executive Director of Taishin’s Private Banking and High‑End Wealth Management Division, and featured a strategic alliance memorandum of understanding with Union Bancaire Privée (UBP). Leveraging UBP—one of the largest family‑owned private banks in Switzerland—for its expertise in high‑net‑worth wealth management and international investment will further strengthen Taishin Private Bank’s global perspective and service capacity.

Taishin Private Banking’s Executive Director Lin Shang‑kai noted that, as the Taishin‑Shin Kong Financial Holding merger gradually yields scale benefits, the customer base has grown to over 11.0 million accounts. To meet the rapidly expanding demand for high‑end wealth management, Taishin Bank officially established a “Private Banking and High‑End Wealth Management Division” in 2026, assembling a team of wealth‑planning advisors with more than 20 years of financial experience and CFP, AFP certifications, alongside seasoned lawyers and accountants. This bolsters comprehensive wealth‑planning services for high‑net‑worth clients. Facing global tax changes and generational business transitions, Taishin’s family‑office offers five core services—family investment management, wealth succession, tax services, family governance, and lifestyle concierge—to deliver full‑suite advisory support to affluent families.

Seeing the huge resource advantage and deep local customer expertise that will result from the Taishin‑Shin Kong merger, Michael Blake, President of UBP’s Asia region, said the partnership is built on a shared corporate vision, client‑centric focus and highly complementary strengths. Taishin precisely understands the needs of Taiwan’s high‑net‑worth market, while UBP brings global investment insight and international wealth‑management experience. Going forward, UBP will share global market insights, asset‑allocation and investment expertise, and through talent development and professional exchange will help Taishin’s private‑banking team broaden its international outlook and deepen its capabilities, jointly advancing Taiwan’s private‑banking services.

Taishin Bank has been cultivating wealth management for 35 years, continuously investing in services for high‑net‑worth clients and gradually building a complete private‑banking ecosystem that includes professional teams, product platforms, and locations in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Singapore. The strategic cooperation with UBP is most significant for translating international experience into client‑service capability. In the future, Taishin will combine its precise grasp of the Taiwan market and high‑net‑worth client needs with UBP’s global market insight and expertise, continuously refining asset allocation, product offerings and wealth‑management skills to deliver more comprehensive, professional and internationally‑oriented private‑banking services.

Looking ahead, Taishin Private Bank will remain rooted in Taiwan, connect to Asia and link to the world, embodying the spirit of “serious professionalism and sustainable inheritance.” It pledges to “protect your entrusted assets,” aiming to become a trusted “asset‑liability management partner” for high‑net‑worth individuals and families, helping clients manage wealth prudently, create long‑term value, and achieve cross‑generational wealth sustainability and legacy.

items.title: AI資料中心排擠車用電子供應 Gentex記憶體、PCB成本上漲下修毛利率財測
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Squeeze Automotive Electronics Suppliers; Gentex Faces Higher Memory and PCB Costs, Cuts Gross Margin Forecast
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國車用後視鏡與座艙電子供應商Gentex(GNTX-US)宣布下修2026年全年毛利率財測，由原先34.5%至35.5%降至34%至34.5%，主要受到貴金屬、記憶體及其他電子零組件成本上漲影響。隨著AI資料中心持續擴建，部分上游材料與產能轉向AI相關用途，使車用電子供應鏈面臨更大的採購壓力。公司預估第四季將額外增加1,000萬至1,500萬美元（約新台幣3.2億至4.9億元）成本，但相關客戶補償最快要到2027年上半年才有機會取得。
Gentex第三季營收6.48億美元，較去年同期的6.55億美元小幅下滑；毛利率由34.4%降至33.4%，歸屬公司淨利也從1.01億美元減少至9,060萬美元。除了貴金屬價格上漲，公司指出，產品組合較不利，加上銷售量低於預期，使工廠無法充分發揮生產規模效益，進一步增加單位製造成本。
值得注意的是，成本壓力已從傳統原物料延伸至電子零組件。Gentex管理層在法說會表示，記憶體及其他電子零組件供應吃緊，使公司被迫接受較高的採購價格，部分印刷電路板（PCB）上游材料與產能也轉向資料中心市場，使車用PCB供應更加緊張。公司目前正透過提前備料、爭取供貨及修改產品設計等方式，降低材料短缺與價格上漲的影響。
Gentex已將2026年全年營收預估由26.5億至27.5億美元，下修至約26.5億美元，但仍維持2027年營收28億至29億美元的展望。公司主要產品包括電子後視鏡、駕駛監控及座艙監控系統，車用業務約占第三季營收85%。隨著車用電子功能持續增加，單車搭載產品價值有機會提高，但在整車需求成長有限、電子材料成本持續上漲的情況下，供應商能否順利向車廠轉嫁成本，仍將影響後續獲利表現。

優分析觀點
值得注意的是，這也是目前整體汽車零組件產業共同面臨的壓力。隨著記憶體、PCB及其他電子材料價格持續上漲，供應商的製造成本不斷增加，但終端汽車需求仍相對疲弱，車廠對零組件價格的控制力較強，使供應商難以將成本立即轉嫁給客戶。
以Gentex為例，即使記憶體、PCB及貴金屬採購成本持續上升，公司仍須與車廠重新協商報價，相關補償預計要到2027年上半年才有機會取得。換句話說，供應商必須先吸收成本上漲的壓力，等到後續調價或取得補償，獲利才可能逐漸改善。
對汽車零組件產業而言，2027年除了觀察終端需求能否回升，更要注意電子材料成本上漲的速度，以及供應商能否透過產品升級與重新議價，讓售價成長跟上成本增加。若材料持續漲價，但車廠採購需求沒有同步改善，零組件供應商反而可能面臨營收成長有限、毛利率持續承壓的情況。

paras_en: On October 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. automotive rear‑view mirror and cockpit electronics supplier Gentex (GNTX‑US) announced it is lowering its 2026 full‑year gross‑margin outlook from the prior range of 34.5%‑35.5% to 34%‑34.5%, mainly due to rising costs for precious metals, memory and other electronic components. As AI data centers continue to expand, some upstream materials and capacity are being redirected to AI‑related uses, putting greater procurement pressure on the automotive electronics supply chain. The company estimates an additional $10‑15 million (about NT$320‑490 million) of cost in the fourth quarter, but compensation from affected customers is not expected until the first half of 2027.

Gentex reported third‑quarter revenue of $648 million, a slight decline from $655 million a year earlier; gross margin fell from 34.4% to 33.4%, and net profit attributable to the company dropped from $101 million to $90.6 million. In addition to higher precious‑metal prices, the company said its product mix was less favorable and sales volumes were below expectations, preventing factories from achieving scale efficiencies and further raising unit manufacturing costs.

Notably, cost pressure has spread from traditional raw materials to electronic components. Gentex’s management said at the earnings call that tight supplies of memory and other electronic parts forced the company to accept higher purchase prices, and some upstream PCB materials and capacity have also shifted to the data‑center market, tightening automotive PCB supply. The company is mitigating the impact of material shortages and price hikes by pre‑stocking, securing supply contracts and redesigning products.

Gentex has trimmed its 2026 full‑year revenue guidance from $2.65‑$2.75 billion to roughly $2.65 billion, while still maintaining a 2027 revenue outlook of $2.8‑$2.9 billion. Its main products include electronic rear‑view mirrors, driver‑monitoring and cockpit‑monitoring systems, with automotive sales accounting for about 85% of third‑quarter revenue. As automotive electronic functions continue to increase, the value per vehicle could rise, but limited overall vehicle demand and persistently rising electronic material costs mean the ability of suppliers to pass costs onto automakers will still affect future profitability.

U‑Analysis view: This pressure is shared across the entire automotive components industry. With memory, PCB and other electronic material prices continuously climbing, manufacturers’ production costs keep rising, yet end‑vehicle demand remains relatively weak and automakers retain strong pricing power over components, making it difficult for suppliers to immediately pass costs to customers.

Using Gentex as an example, even though memory, PCB and precious‑metal procurement costs keep rising, the company still has to renegotiate pricing with automakers, with any compensation not expected until the first half of 2027. In other words, suppliers must initially absorb the cost increase and only see profit improvement after later price adjustments or compensation.

For the automotive components sector, 2027 will require watching whether end‑demand rebounds, but also the speed of electronic material cost increases and whether suppliers can upgrade products and renegotiate terms so that selling prices keep pace with cost growth. If material prices keep rising while automakers’ purchasing demand does not improve in tandem, component suppliers could face limited revenue growth and sustained margin pressure.

items.title: 半導體暴跌散戶受重擊！摩根大通：資金未撤出AI交易 反而擴大布局
paras: 分析師指出，散戶投資人在過去一周積極搶進人工智慧(AI)概念半導體股，但他們都在周四(22日)的市場重挫中遭受重創。
摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)策略師Arun Jain表示，根據上周四至本周三的交易資金流向，散戶過去一周加碼買進晶片製造商、新型雲端服務(neocloud)商以及記憶體製造商。相較之下，對「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven)的買盤則有所減弱。
Jain表示，散戶對個別科技股的買入力道，已升至7月動能交易退潮以來的最高水準。

半導體股重挫 散戶熱門標的同步下跌

由於市場憂心AI基礎設施支出過於龐大，標普500指數周四收黑，晶片股領跌，半導體類股指標下跌6.7%，創6月以來最大單日跌幅。這使散戶投資人承受沉重壓力。
散戶買進最多的個股包括SanDisk(SNDK-US)、台積電(TSM-US)，以及近來社群媒體的散戶投資論壇中受矚目的Nebius Group(NBIS-S)，這三家公司股價周四均下跌至少4%。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)截至周二是散戶熱門買進標的第四名，但該公司公布令人鼓舞的財報、周二盤後股價大漲7.8%後，投資人轉而賣出。

科技ETF吸金創紀錄 散戶並未撤出AI交易

散戶對科技類股ETF的需求更為強勁。上周科技ETF資金流入規模創歷史第二高，部分原因是散戶在上周後半逢低買進。
科技ETF單日流入金額在上周五刷新歷史紀錄，使全周買進規模增至高於歷史平均值2.1個標準差的水準。VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)也是吸引大量資金的基金之一。
摩根大通的數據顯示，自各大雲端服務業者7月公布強勁財報迄今，散戶原本一直偏好科技七巨頭，如今資金轉向該群組以外的股票，顯示散戶並未因市場波動加劇而放棄AI交易，而是擴大投資範圍。
Integrity資產管理公司投資組合經理Joe Gilbert說：「由於AI生態系展現出比最初預期更持久的獲利能力，投資人已從科技七巨頭轉向更廣泛的科技股。」

科技業獲利成長支撐買盤 通膨疑慮仍添壓力

今年科技業一直是企業獲利成長的重要推手，根據美國銀行(BofA)彙整的數據，標普500資訊科技指數成分股企業第3季獲利預估將成長66%，增幅僅次於能源與通訊服務類股。
Gilbert說：「即使在科技七巨頭以外的領域，尤其是在利率較高的環境下，投資人仍有可能以較低的本益比，找到獲利強勁成長的機會。」
不過。目前散戶對科技股的熱情尚未轉化為全面的買盤激增。摩根大通數據顯示，散戶該周的整體資金流向仍相對平淡。

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 美股分裂成兩大陣營！AI股與其他類股多空拉鋸 投資人被甩得暈頭轉向
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Split Into Two Camps: AI Shares vs. Others, Investors Left Dizzy
paras: 美國股市分裂成兩大陣營的態勢愈來愈明顯，市場走勢宛如蹺蹺板，一端是人工智慧(AI)概念股，另一端則是其他類股。
標普500指數周四(22日)下跌逾1%，創7月以來最差表現，但同一天仍有超過300檔標普500成分股收漲。根據道瓊市場數據，大盤指數與成分股之間出現如此劇烈的分歧走勢，前一次發生在2025年1月。
市場戲劇性變化也反映出AI交易熱潮正面臨壓力。CNN的「恐懼與貪婪指數」發出強烈的恐懼訊號，而10年期美國公債殖利率則創下矽谷銀行(SVB)倒閉以來最大單日跌幅。
然而，通用磨坊(General Mills)(GIS-US)與金寶湯(Campbell’s)(CPB-US)等民生消費必需品類股周四分別大漲8%及8.7%，仍不足彌補熱門AI概念股的跌勢。
費城半導體指數(SOX)當天收黑6.72%，與6月高點相比回落逾26%，正式遁入「熊市」。投資人今年稍早大舉買進被視為AI產業「瓶頸」受惠者的股票，曾推動費半指數在短短數個月內翻倍，如今卻已大幅回檔。

AI股與其他類股像蹺蹺板 市場輪動加劇

Nationwide首席市場策略師Mark Hackett表示，這只是美股日益分裂成兩大陣營的最新例證，2026年的交易走勢開始像蹺蹺板，一端是AI概念股，另一端則是其他所有類股，「領漲類股出現如此頻繁的變化，實屬罕見。」
美國銀行資產管理集團(U.S. Bank Asset Management Group)投資長Dan Farley指出，投資人在兩大陣營之間反覆轉換，持續的來回震盪讓一部分人感到暈頭轉向。
Farley以形容這種情況「就像坐上遊樂園的旋轉飛椅一樣，人會被甩來甩去」。

指數與成分股走勢分歧創紀錄

美股多頭行情已持續四年，市場對AI提升勞動生產力與企業獲利的期待，推升標普500指數與科技股為主的那斯達克綜合指數，使兩大指數的權重愈來愈集中於被視為AI建置受惠者的企業。
標普500指數成分股的平均表現，與市場認為的AI受惠股愈來愈脫節。目前標普500市值最大的10家公司，合計約占整體指數市值的40%，由於標普500採市值加權，個股市值愈大，對指數每日漲跌的影響也愈大。
以截至周四收盤的行情來看，標普500等權重指數有望收漲，但被視為AI交易核心的費半指數則可能收跌。若周五行情沒有大幅逆轉，兩大指數將連續第八周走勢相反，創下可追溯至1990年代中期以來最長紀錄。

資金仍留在市場 但分析師警告恐出現同步賣壓

瑞穗美洲(Mizuho Americas)股票交易部門執行董事Farzin Azarm認為，這種分歧未必全是壞事，投資人並非把資金撤出市場，而是持續在不同類股之間調整配置。
Azarm說：「類股輪動正在加速，但投資人實際上只是在市場內部重新調動資金。」
大型機構投資人、例如避險基金，也正在加速這項趨勢。高盛(Goldman Sachs)主要券商業務部門近期數據顯示，避險基金客戶已大幅降低整體槓桿部位。
Azarm說：「去槓桿的幅度相當大，但在我看來，這其實是個好現象。」
不過，也有市場人士抱持較悲觀的看法。BTIG分析師Jonathan Krinsky周四指出，2026年指數表現與市場廣度之間的分歧達到極端程度。
今年超過30%的交易日中，標普500指數的漲跌方向與多數成分股相反，遠高於1996年以來任何一個完整年度的紀錄。若過往經驗仍具參考價值，指數成分股之間如此極端的表現分歧，恐怕難以無止境地持續下去。
Krinsky寫道：「我們認為，這種持續不斷的類股輪動終將停止，屆時市場可能出現相關性更高、各類股同步下跌的賣壓。」
paras_en: The divide in the U.S. equity market into two major camps is becoming increasingly clear, with market movement resembling a seesaw—one side occupied by artificial intelligence (AI) concept stocks and the other by all other sectors.

The S&P 500 fell more than 1% on Thursday the 22nd, marking its worst performance since July, yet over 300 S&P 500 constituents posted gains that same day. According to Dow Jones market data, such a stark divergence between the broad index and its components last occurred in January 2025.

The market’s dramatic swing also reflects mounting pressure on the AI trading frenzy. CNN’s Fear & Greed Index flashed a strong fear signal, while the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield posted its biggest single‑day drop since the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB).
Nevertheless, consumer staples such as General Mills (GIS‑US) and Campbell’s (CPB‑US) surged 8% and 8.7% respectively on Thursday, still insufficient to offset the decline in hot AI concept stocks.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) closed down 6.72% that day, more than 26% below its June peak, officially entering a bear market. Investors had earlier this year heavily bought stocks seen as beneficiaries of AI industry bottlenecks, which had helped double the SOX in just a few months, but those gains have now largely erased.

AI stocks and other sectors act like a seesaw, with market rotation intensifying. Nationwide chief market strategist Mark Hackett said this is merely the latest illustration of the U.S. market’s growing split into two camps, with 2026 trading dynamics now resembling a seesaw—one side AI concepts, the other all other sectors, and such frequent shifts among leading stocks are rare.

U.S. Bank Asset Management Group chief investment officer Dan Farley noted that investors keep flipping between the two camps, and the continual back‑and‑forth swings are leaving some people feeling dizzy.
Farley likened the situation to “riding a spinning swing at an amusement park—people get tossed around.”

Record divergence between index and component performance. The four‑year bull market in U.S. equities has been driven by expectations that AI will boost labor productivity and corporate earnings, lifting the S&P 500 and the tech‑heavy Nasdaq Composite, concentrating weight in firms seen as AI beneficiaries.

The average performance of S&P 500 constituents is increasingly out of sync with stocks perceived as AI winners. The ten largest companies by market cap now account for roughly 40% of the index’s total value, and because the S&P 500 is market‑cap weighted, larger stocks have a greater impact on daily index moves.

Based on Thursday’s closing data, equal‑weight S&P 500 indices could still end up higher, while the AI‑focused SOX is likely to close lower. If Friday’s session does not see a sharp reversal, the two indices will mark an eighth consecutive week of opposite moves—the longest such streak traceable back to the mid‑1990s.

Capital remains in the market, but analysts warn of possible synchronized selling pressure. Farzin Azarm, executive director of the equities trading division at Mizuho Americas, believes the split isn’t necessarily all bad; investors are not pulling money out of the market but are reallocating across sectors.
Azarm said, “Sector rotation is accelerating, but investors are essentially just shifting capital within the market.”

Large institutional players, such as hedge funds, are also accelerating this trend. Recent data from Goldman Sachs’ main brokerage division show hedge‑fund clients have sharply reduced overall leverage positions.
Azarm added, “The de‑leveraging is substantial, but in my view that’s actually a positive sign.”

However, some market participants hold a more pessimistic view. BTIG analyst Jonathan Krinsky noted on Thursday that the divergence between index performance and market breadth in 2026 has reached an extreme level.

More than 30% of trading days this year saw the S&P 500’s direction opposite that of the majority of its components, far exceeding any full‑year record since 1996. If history remains a guide, such an extreme split in component performance is unlikely to persist indefinitely.
Krinsky wrote, “We believe this relentless sector rotation will eventually cease, at which point the market may face higher correlation and a synchronized sell‑off across sectors.”

items.title: AI股快跌完了？小摩喊賣壓近尾聲 科技業握4000億美元後盾
items.title_en: Is the AI Stock Decline Almost Over? JPMorgan Says Selling Pressure Nears End, Tech Sector Backed by $400 Billion Financing Cushion
paras: 摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 在最新客戶報告中指出，近期人工智慧（AI）相關概念股的拋售潮可能已接近尾聲，並指出自9月中旬以來，股票部位已出現顯著的去槓桿與重置跡象。
策略師Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou表示，摩根大通的整體股票部位指標顯示，目前持倉水位已遠低於近期高峰。儘管短期仍面臨部分逆風，但部位調整可能開始抑制進一步下跌空間。
針對近期市場對「新興雲端業者」（Neoclouds）融資困境的疑慮，小摩認為，即使這類業者的融資模式證實無法持續，也不會打亂整體AI的資本支出（Capex）週期。Panigirtzoglou寫道：「在新興雲端業者既非整體AI生態系的核心，所佔比重也並不大。」
在今年全球上市科技公司預計產生的約2.2兆美元現金流與1.8兆美元資本支出中，新興雲端業者僅分別佔約300億美元及800億美元。
換言之，新興雲端業者所建置的AI基礎設施，完全可由超大規模雲端業者（Hyperscalers）等資產負債表更健全、營收來源多元的其他科技巨頭所吸收。
報告進一步指出，由於現金流超過資本支出，今年科技產業整體仍擁有約4,000億美元的融資盈餘。
小摩表示，科技業發債主因是為了在擴大資本支出的同時維持股票回購；倘若融資疑慮擴散，企業大可延後回購或進行更多循環融資。
換句話說，整體科技產業透過維持融資盈餘，自身即具備充足的內部資金後盾。
摩根大通指出，半導體目前約占全球股市整體風險資本的5分之1，因此容易受到波動加劇所引發的賣壓衝擊。該行研判，避險基金及商品交易顧問（CTA）等動能型投資人，已大致平倉先前偏高的半導體多頭部位。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US) noted in its latest client report that the recent sell‑off in AI‑related stocks may be nearing its end, observing significant deleveraging and repositioning in equity holdings since mid‑September.

Strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou said JPMorgan’s overall equity position indicator shows current holdings are far below recent peaks. While short‑term headwinds remain, the position adjustments could start limiting further downside.

Addressing recent market concerns about financing difficulties for “emerging cloud providers” (Neoclouds), JPMorgan believes that even if these firms’ financing models prove unsustainable, it won’t disrupt the overall AI capital‑expenditure (Capex) cycle. Panigirtzoglou wrote: “Emerging cloud providers are not core to the broader AI ecosystem and represent a small share.”

Of the roughly $2.2 trillion in cash flow and $1.8 trillion in Capex expected from globally listed tech companies this year, emerging cloud providers account for only about $30 billion and $80 billion respectively.

In other words, the AI infrastructure built by emerging cloud providers can be fully absorbed by larger, more financially robust tech giants such as hyperscalers, which have diversified revenue streams and stronger balance sheets.
The report further notes that because cash flow exceeds Capex, the tech sector as a whole still enjoys about $400 billion of financing surplus this year.

JPMorgan says the primary reason tech firms issue debt is to maintain share buybacks while expanding Capex; if financing concerns spread, companies can simply postpone buybacks or pursue additional revolving financing.
Put simply, by preserving a financing surplus, the tech industry already has ample internal funding support.

JPMorgan points out that semiconductors currently represent roughly one‑fifth of global equity market risk capital, making them vulnerable to heightened selling pressure from increased volatility. The bank assesses that momentum investors such as hedge funds and commodity trading advisors (CTAs) have largely unwound their previously oversized long positions in semiconductors.

items.title: 星巴克開始在中國認真管座位 消費者反應曝
items.title_en: Starbucks Starts Seriously Managing Seats in China, Consumer Reactions Revealed
paras: 星巴克(SBUX-US) 在中國開始把座位優先留給消費的人，但如何提醒點單，又成了新爭議。
「在星巴克開會一小時被提醒點單五次」在23日（周五）登上熱搜。上海一位消費者說，臨時參加線上會議，原本打算會後下單，卻在約一個半小時內被店員五次提醒。
她認為消費入座可以理解，但反覆催促讓她感到被「攆走」，最終去了附近另一家星巴克消費。
同一天，位於深圳福田居民區的一家星巴克，現場執行相對寬鬆。
據《界面新聞》報導，一位店員說，目前工作人員會對消費入座進行管理，是為了保障消費顧客的權益，「不然我們店裡的顧客都沒地方坐」。
這位店員表示，這家門市至少10天前就已開始進行管理，近幾日才擺上「請消費入座」桌牌。
工作日下午2點，這家擁有兩層空間的星巴克，上座率接近七成，攜帶電腦辦公的消費者接近一半，幾乎所有顧客的桌上都擺有星巴克飲品。
一個小時內，仍有三兩名顧客未點單短暫入座歇息，店員也未上前提醒消費。
本月22日起，星巴克在全中國門市施行消費入座，消費者的反應大致分為兩類：一類認為座位更好找、環境更安靜；另一類擔心過去可以自在停留的咖啡店，會變成不斷被詢問點單的地方。
支持者往往有過找不到座位的經歷。一位長期購買星巴克的消費者在社交平台上提到，過去曾遇到有人躺在座位上、吃外食或高聲交談，新規帶來的好處是，「起碼我能坐窗口了」。
也有消費者稱，到店感覺人少了，留下來的大多是已經點單、安靜辦公的顧客。
不滿則更多集中在提醒的頻率與時機。店內空位充裕時，店員是否需要反覆詢問？顧客表示稍後下單後，可以等多久？
門市之間也有尺度差異。據《新快報》報導，廣州有店員表示，顧客入座約10分鐘未點單會上前提醒；但同城另一家客流較少的門市，顧客入座25分鐘也未被詢問。
paras_en: Starbucks (SBUX-US) has begun giving priority to customers who actually purchase in China, but how to remind them to order has become a new controversy.

“Being reminded to order five times during a one‑hour meeting at Starbucks” trended on the hot search list on the 23rd (Friday). A consumer in Shanghai said she joined an impromptu online meeting, planned to order after it ended, but was reminded by staff five times within about an hour and a half.

She said she can understand the policy of seating only paying customers, but the repeated prompts made her feel like she was being “shooed away,” and she ultimately went to another nearby Starbucks to make her purchase.
On the same day, a Starbucks in a residential area of Futian, Shenzhen, was enforcing the rule more loosely on site.

According to Jiemian News, a staff member said that employees now manage seating for paying customers in order to protect their rights, “otherwise our customers would have nowhere to sit in the store.”
The employee said the store had started enforcing the policy at least ten days ago, and only in recent days had it put up a “Please seat only if you have ordered” sign on the tables.
At 2 p.m. on a weekday afternoon, the two‑level Starbucks was about 70 % full, with nearly half of the patrons using laptops for work, and almost every table had a Starbucks drink on it.
Within an hour, a few customers still sat briefly without ordering, and the staff did not approach them to remind them to order.

Starting on the 22nd of this month, Starbucks began applying the “pay‑to‑sit” rule in all its stores across China. Consumer reactions fall into two main camps: one says seats are easier to find and the environment quieter; the other worries that cafés, once places to linger freely, will become spots where you’re constantly asked to order.

Supporters often have past experiences of not finding a seat. A long‑time Starbucks buyer posted on social media that she used to encounter people lying on seats, eating take‑out, or speaking loudly, and the new rule’s benefit is that “at least I can sit by the window now.”
Other customers say the stores feel less crowded, and those who stay are mostly people who have already ordered and are working quietly.

Dissatisfaction focuses more on the frequency and timing of the reminders. When there are plenty of empty seats, should staff repeatedly ask? Customers wonder how long they can wait after they intend to order later.

There are also differences between stores. According to Xin Kuai Bao, a staff member in Guangzhou said customers are reminded after about ten minutes of sitting without ordering, whereas another less‑busy store in the same city does not ask even after 25 minutes of seating.

items.title: Meta擬發無投票權新股，為AI籌資並保住祖克柏控制權
items.title_en: Meta Plans to Issue Non-Voting Shares to Fund AI and Preserve Zuckerberg's Control
paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Meta Platforms(META-US)計畫新增無投票權的C類股票，作為AI投資、併購及員工獎酬工具，在籌措資金的同時，維持執行長祖克柏的控制權，新股預計2027年1月開始交易。
現有股東每持有一股A類或B類股票，將獲配一股C類股票，效果類似一拆二。這次配股本身不會帶來新資金，Meta後續可再發行C類股募資，也可用於支付併購對價或員工薪酬。
資金需求來自AI建設。Meta預估2026年資本支出達1,350億至1,450億美元，用於資料中心、晶片與運算基礎設施。公司指出，若大規模依賴舉債，可能影響信用評等，因此希望增加股權融資彈性。
截至10月1日，祖克柏持有約13.4%股權，透過具有較高投票權的B類股，掌握約60.6%投票權。發行無投票權股票，可讓公司擴大股本而不明顯削弱其控制力；不過，後續增發仍可能稀釋既有股東的持股比例與每股盈餘。
此安排也涉及祖克柏個人資金需求。加州預計11月交付表決的第40號提案，擬對符合條件的億萬富豪課徵一次性5%財富稅，尚未定案。C類股可讓他出售部分股份而不立即降低投票權，但依相關協議，他及特定受讓人獲配的C類股僅20%可立即自由出售，其餘仍受限制。

paras_en: On October 23, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), Meta Platforms (META-US) announced plans to add a non‑voting Class C share, to be used as a tool for AI investment, acquisitions and employee compensation, raising capital while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s control. The new shares are expected to begin trading in January 2027.

Existing shareholders will receive one Class C share for each Class A or B share they hold, effectively a one‑for‑two split. This allocation itself does not bring in new cash; Meta can later issue Class C shares to raise funds, or use them to pay acquisition consideration or employee compensation.

The funding need stems from AI construction. Meta estimates 2026 capital expenditures of $135‑$145 billion for data centers, chips and computing infrastructure. The company notes that heavy reliance on debt could affect its credit rating, so it seeks greater flexibility through equity financing.

As of October 1, Zuckerberg owned about 13.4% of the equity and, through the higher‑voting Class B shares, controlled roughly 60.6% of the voting power. Issuing non‑voting shares would let the company expand its equity base without markedly weakening his control, though subsequent issuances could still dilute existing shareholders’ ownership percentages and earnings per share.

The arrangement also touches on Zuckerberg’s personal financing needs. California is slated to vote in November on Proposal 40, which would impose a one‑time 5% wealth tax on qualifying billionaires, though it has not yet been finalized. Class C shares would allow him to sell part of his stake without immediately reducing voting power, but under related agreements only 20% of the Class C shares allocated to him and certain transferees can be sold freely right away, with the remainder subject to restrictions.
